Definition: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead, and Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh-gilead.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jabesh-gilead carries two opposite memories: the city that did not come up to Mizpeh and was judged for it, and the city Saul saved from Nahash, and the same name holds the shame and the rescue together.
